details.summary:
An Adventure Among Rocks & Caves

Anthargange in Kolar is a rocky hill range known for large volcanic boulders, natural cave formations and green surroundings. Located about 60 km from Bangalore, it offers a short outdoor escape for travellers who enjoy light trekking, rock exploration and discovering unusual natural formations.

The trail begins with a flight of steps leading towards an ancient temple before opening into a more natural landscape of rocks and boulders. As the climb continues, thorny shrubs and cave-like formations add variety to the experience.

itinerary.title: Bangalore to Anthargange
itinerary.description: Your Anthargange adventure begins late at night as you leave Bengaluru for Kolar.

activities.title: Board Vehicle
activities.description: Meet your trip coordinator at the designated pickup point and board the vehicle towards Anthargange. Settle in and travel with the group through the night.

activities.title: Early Morning | Arrive at Anthargange Base
activities.description: Reach the designated base area, get ready for the trek and attend a short briefing from your trek leader before starting the ascent.

itinerary.title: Explore Anthargange
itinerary.route: Trek, Cave Exploration & Descent | Return to Bengaluru
itinerary.description: Begin the early-morning climb through the rocky landscape of Anthargange, keeping together with the group.

activities.title: Early Morning | Begin the Trek
activities.description: Start the ascent through the rocky trail. The route includes steps, boulders and natural sections leading towards the upper part of the hill.

activities.title: Morning | Cave Exploration
activities.description: Spend time exploring Anthargange's natural cave formations. Some spaces can be narrow, so move carefully and use your headlamp or torch while exploring.

activities.title: Morning | Begin the Descent
activities.description: Start the descent with your trek leader. Take care on the rocky sections and stay with the group throughout the return route.

activities.title: Trek Ends
activities.description: Reach the base and take some time to rest and freshen up after the trek and cave exploration.

activities.title: Breakfast Stop
activities.description: Stop at a local restaurant or en-route eatery for breakfast.

sections.title: A Trek with a Story
sections.body:
Anthargange is associated with a perennial spring that emerges through the rocks near the temple. The name Anthargange refers to an inner stream, and the spring is one of the distinctive features of the hill.

The hill is home to the Kashi Vishweshwara Temple, and the rocky landscape around it has formed small and large cave-like spaces. Some sections are narrow and may require careful movement while exploring.

The climb is relatively short, and the upper section opens towards a broad green plateau with views across the surrounding landscape. The combination of rocky terrain, temple surroundings, natural formations and cave exploration gives Anthargange its distinct character.

sections.title: Things to carry
sections.body:
Things to Carry for Anthargange Trek (Since the trek begins during the early hours and includes cave exploration, packing the right essentials is important.)

[Must Carry]

• Small trekking backpack
• At least 2 litres of drinking water
• Headlamp or torch (especially important for cave exploration)
• Trekking shoes with good grip
• Light jacket or windcheater
• Extra pair of socks
• Cap
• Sunglasses
• Sunscreen
• Energy bars or dry fruits
• Personal medication

• Fully charged mobile phone
• Power bank
• Valid government-issued ID
[During Monsoon]

• Rain jacket or poncho
• Waterproof backpack cover
• Waterproof phone pouch
• Extra clothes and socks Packing Tip

Keep your backpack light. Avoid carrying unnecessary items while moving across uneven rocky terrain and during cave exploration.

sections.title: Trail guidelines
sections.body:
Anthargange is a natural rocky destination with temple and cave areas. Help preserve the hill and respect the surroundings.

"Trek Responsibly. Respect the Hills."

• Follow your trek leader's instructions at all times.
• Follow Forest Department rules, permit conditions and restrictions.
• Stay with the group throughout the trek.
• Remain on the designated trekking trail.
• Move carefully through narrow cave sections.
• Use a headlamp or torch while exploring caves.
• Do not litter.
• Carry all waste back with you.
• Avoid single-use plastic.
• Do not smoke or consume alcohol during the trek.
• Do not light fires or campfires.
• Do not disturb wildlife.
• Do not damage plants, rocks or temple structures.
• Be careful around steep and rocky sections.
• Avoid standing too close to edges while taking photographs.
• Wear appropriate trekking footwear.
• Stay hydrated throughout the trek.
• Take breaks whenever required.
• Avoid loud music that may disturb wildlife and fellow trekkers. "Leave Only Footprints. Take Only Memories."
